entities.name: green soccer field
entities.identification: The green grass soccer field occupying the main part of the frame, with the penalty area, goal area, penalty arc, and end line visible.

entities.name: sideline advertising barrier
entities.identification: Long advertising boards arranged along the outer edge of the field, with different background colors, text, and graphics.

entities.name: group of players in green clothing
entities.identification: The set of on-field players wearing green shirts, green shorts, and white knee-high socks, excluding Person D.

entities.name: group of players in dark clothing
entities.identification: The set of on-field players wearing blue-and-black shirts, dark shorts, and soccer socks, including the near-side member with the ball.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The goalkeeper moving in front of Object D, wearing a bright orange jersey, shorts, and knee-high socks.

entities.name: soccer ball
entities.identification: The small white spherical object near the near-side member of the group of players in dark clothing who has the ball.

entities.name: Object D
entities.identification: The white goal defended by Person D, with two side posts, a crossbar, and a light-colored net surface behind it.

entities.name: gray tiered stands
entities.identification: The gray stands in the upper part and left-side background of the frame, with tiered seating, passageways, and railings.

entities.name: group of spectators in the stands
entities.identification: The group of small human figures concentrated in the seating area from the upper center to the right side of the frame.

entities.name: off-field group of people in vests
entities.identification: People dispersed along the outer edge of the field wearing bright yellow or orange upper-body clothing; the near-side standing person wears a bright yellow vest and dark lower-body clothing.

entities.name: off-field gray rigid passageway
entities.identification: The gray strip of hard ground between the bottom of the stands and the sideline advertising barrier.

entities.name: white advertising surface beyond the end line
entities.identification: The rectangular white-background advertising surfaces beyond the end line on both sides of Object D, with large black text and red graphics.
